policy: Curated prototype routes, independent of frozen profile-family identities. All 163 released rules7 routes and gates remain. Nine further ordinary stage advances from the pinned DigiGame forward table close nine lower-stage leaves, producing 172 total routes. The source-authored family alternatives are deliberate prototype choices; their level/bond gates use our target profiles, not source game requirements. The graph stays acyclic with at most two outgoing choices. All 276 forms remain encounter/capture eligible by combat tier. No exclusive canonical path, exact World DS requirement, Armor conversion, mode change, or fusion mechanic is implied.
